summary_short.zh: curl 是一个命令行工具和库，通过 URL 语法传输数据，支持 HTTP、FTP、SFTP 等 20 多种协议。它的核心优势在于简洁和通用——一条命令即可处理多种协议，无需额外工具。开发者可将 libcurl 嵌入应用，用于文件传输、API 测试或自动化。你可以用它下载文件、测试接口，或编写脚本实现复杂的数据处理流程。

summaries.en: curl is a command-line tool and library for transferring data using URL syntax, supporting over 20 protocols including HTTP, FTP, and SFTP. Its key strength lies in its simplicity and universality—one command handles diverse protocols without additional tools. Developers can embed libcurl into applications for file transfers, API testing, or automation. Use it to download files, test endpoints, or script complex data workflows.

summary_short.zh: Beads 是一个为编程智能体提供持久记忆的开源工具，解决了智能体在跨会话中丢失上下文的问题。它通过一个结构化的持久化存储，让智能体能够读写长期记忆，从而保持对项目的持续理解。技术亮点在于其简洁的 API 设计，可以轻松集成到 Claude Code 等编码代理中，使它们能记住之前的决策和代码修改。你可以用它来增强自己的编码助手，让它在大型、持续的项目中表现更连贯、更高效。

summaries.en: Beads is a memory upgrade for coding agents, solving the problem of agents forgetting context across sessions. It uses a persistent, structured memory store that agents can read and write, enabling long-term project awareness. Technically, it integrates via a simple API, allowing agents like Claude Code to recall past decisions and code changes. You can use it to give your coding agent continuity, making it more effective on large, ongoing projects.

summary_short.zh: CUA 是一个开源基础设施，用于构建和评估能够控制桌面（macOS、Linux、Windows）的计算机使用智能体。它提供沙盒环境、SDK 和基准测试，使 AI 智能体能够安全地训练和测试点击、输入、导航等 GUI 任务。技术核心是通过容器化隔离智能体操作，确保可复现性和安全性。开发者可以利用 CUA 快速原型化桌面自动化智能体，在标准基准上评估其性能，或将其集成到更大的 AI 工作流中。

summaries.en: CUA is an open-source infrastructure for building and evaluating computer-use agents that control desktops (macOS, Linux, Windows). It provides sandboxed environments, SDKs, and benchmarks, enabling safe training and testing of AI agents that perform GUI tasks like clicking, typing, and navigating. Technically, it uses containerization to isolate agent actions, ensuring reproducibility and safety. Developers can use CUA to prototype desktop automation agents, benchmark their performance, or integrate it into larger AI workflows.
